i.norm: Verifies the unlimited (no-threshold) Levenshtein distance between two CharSequences that each contain a single 'S' surrounded by NUL ('�') padding. left : 8 characters -> "S" followed by 7 NULs right : 7 characters -> 3 NULs, then "S", then 3 NULs Transforming left into right requires two single-character edits, so the expected distance is 2.
right side: 'S' located at index 3, all other positions are NUL.
left side: 'S' located at index 0, all other positions are NUL.
